display.$description: Titles and headings only: display, page and document titles, and heading levels. Never tabs, buttons, labels or controls. Newsreader's optical-size axis picks the right cut for each size (font.optical-sizing).

body.$description: All body text and every part of the interface: buttons, tabs, labels, menus and fields. Its I, l and 1 look alike, so codes and IDs use the code font.

data.$description: Numbers and dates use the body font, so there is no extra typeface for them.

code.$description: Code, IDs, file names and keyboard keys. JetBrains Mono keeps I, l, 1, O and 0 clearly apart, where Instrument Sans doesn't.
